LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.SmartStore.DevTools
LocaleResource.Value: Smartstore Developer Tools (MiniProfiler and other goodies).

LocaleResource.Name: EnableMiniProfilerInPublicStore.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Activates the MiniProfiler. With its help you can measure the time from the initial request to the first byte sent to the browser. Only admins can see the profiler widget.

LocaleResource.Name: MiniProfilerIgnorePaths.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: A comma-separated list of paths to be ignored by the MiniProfiler.

LocaleResource.Name: DisplayWidgetZones.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Injects tooltips into every widget zone, which includes the name of the current widget zone. The display of these tooltips is limited to admintrators.

LocaleResource.Name: ActivateZones
LocaleResource.Value: No widget zones are currently enabled. By clicking the icon, you can activate the widget zones.

LocaleResource.Name: DisplayMachineName.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Displays the current machine name below the footer. With this function you can determine the current machine within a distributed application.

LocaleResource.Name: IconBrowser.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Explore the available icons from all kits and libraries. Select a source, search for an icon and try the different variants. A small dot marks icons provided by a plugin.

LocaleResource.Name: CachedIcons.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: This overview shows individually requested cached icons whose specific library and variant are not currently included in any kit. Use their addresses to organize frequently used icons as concepts in a kit or through an icon provider. Drawings already covered by kits are hidden, even when their concept has a different name. Each address appears once; expired or deleted cache entries disappear.

LocaleResource.Name: CachedIcons.Empty
LocaleResource.Value: There are no cached icons outside the kits.

LocaleResource.Name: KitFiles.Empty
LocaleResource.Value: No current kit sprites have been generated yet.

LocaleResource.Name: IconCode.Empty
LocaleResource.Value: Select an icon to generate its code.
